tactics.counter: Apply 3 disruption during Dry hymn to cancel its strain. Cough gains 2 damage per saturated organ: vent before it lands.

pattern.label: Dry hymn · add 2 strain before cooling to 3 organs

enemies.name: Ribbon Leech
enemies.description: It feeds where the ship joins itself.

tactics.name: Conduit parasite
tactics.counter: Unstitch cuts your last route first. Drink repairs the hull damage it actually deals. One-organ attacks deal 5 extra damage; bait cuts and disrupt its feeding turn.

pattern.label: Unstitch · sever 1 link for the round

enemies.name: Kiln Shepherd
enemies.description: It tends the heat that should have died.

tactics.name: Kiln cycle
tactics.counter: Brand has 4 armor. Interrupt Kiln breath with 4 disruption or prepare to vent: Crook gains 3 damage per saturated organ, but takes 5 extra damage per hit.

pattern.label: Kiln breath · add 2 strain before cooling to 4 organs

enemies.name: The Unhatched Sun
enemies.description: A dawn still inside its shell. Its eggs hatch after two enemy phases.

tactics.name: Brood furnace
tactics.counter: Laying has 5 armor but 5 disruption stops the egg. Corona is exposed for 4 extra damage per hit. Fever precedes Shellfall, which gains 2 damage per saturated organ. Kill eggs before they hatch.

pattern.label: Lay an egg · 14 hull; hatches in 2 phases
Fever · add 2 strain before cooling to 3 organs

enemies.name: Toll Scrap
enemies.description: A customs post that learned to drift.

tactics.name: Armored tollgate
tactics.counter: Tariff has 4 armor, followed by a heavier Fine exposed for 4 extra damage per hit. Three-organ attacks gain 5 damage in either phase: build a strong route rather than chip away.

enemies.name: Rivet Widow
enemies.description: She carries a nest of abandoned fasteners.

tactics.name: Rivet ambush
tactics.counter: Unpin has 4 armor and cuts the last route first. Rivet rain has no armor. Secondary split hits gain 6 damage: hit her companion while she prepares.

pattern.label: Unpin · sever 1 link for the round

enemies.name: Choir of Bolts
enemies.description: Each bolt remembers a different ship.

tactics.name: Overload chorus
tactics.counter: Dissonance gains 3 damage per saturated organ. Its following Resonance can be stopped with 3 disruption and takes 3 extra damage per hit. Keep the circuit cool across the cycle.

pattern.label: Resonance · add 2 strain before cooling to 3 organs

enemies.name: Debt Skiff
enemies.description: Its ledger names the living as salvage.

tactics.name: Debt collector
tactics.counter: Collection is the heavy hit; Interest repairs actual hull damage dealt and takes 4 extra damage per hit. One-organ attacks gain 4 damage. Save prevention for the feeding turn when possible.

enemies.name: Magistrate Hulk
enemies.description: An old verdict wrapped in newer wreckage.

tactics.name: Siege court
tactics.counter: Gavel has 5 armor. Refit takes 4 extra damage per hit and 4 disruption cancels its group repair. Adjourn cuts your last route first; use that quiet turn to rebuild your circuit.

pattern.label: Refit · heal every allied enemy by 12
Adjourn · sever 1 link for the round

enemies.name: The Salvage Parliament
enemies.description: Attendants keep its endless session. The assembly rebuilds its members.

tactics.name: Protected assembly
tactics.counter: Each living attendant absorbs 2 damage from every hit on Parliament. Kill attendants first; 5 disruption cancels Ratify repairs. Censure has 3 armor, but Division takes 6 extra damage per hit.

pattern.label: Ratify repairs · heal every allied enemy by 18
Roll call · add 2 strain before cooling to 4 organs

enemies.name: Glass Auditor
enemies.description: It checks the ship against an impossible original.

tactics.name: Route examiner
tactics.counter: Annotate has 3 armor but 3 disruption prevents its route mark. Correction takes 4 extra damage per hit. Three-organ attacks gain 4 damage; vary their order once marked.

pattern.label: Annotate · repeating the last route costs 5 hull

enemies.name: Absence Kite
enemies.description: A hole held open by a graceful frame.

tactics.name: Hollow frame
tactics.counter: Erase cuts your last route first and takes 5 extra damage per hit. Vacuum has 4 armor. Secondary split hits gain 5 damage; exploit the open frame before it closes.

pattern.label: Erase · sever 1 link for the round

enemies.name: Mirror Orphan
enemies.description: It wants the face the ship left behind.

tactics.name: Alternating mirror
tactics.counter: Recognition is a heavy hit with 5 armor. Denial takes 6 extra damage per hit. One-organ attacks gain 6 damage: conserve the circuit while bracing, then punish Denial.

enemies.name: Pale Index
enemies.description: Every lost voyage has a page in it.

tactics.name: Saturation index
tactics.counter: Catalogue targets the most strained organs and can be stopped with 4 disruption. Redaction gains 4 damage per saturated organ. Three-organ attacks gain 6 damage, but vent before the strike.

pattern.label: Catalogue · add 2 strain before cooling to 4 organs

enemies.name: Null Archivist
enemies.description: The last librarian burns the paths between shelves.

tactics.name: Sealed record
tactics.counter: Record has 5 armor but 4 disruption prevents its mark. Seal cuts your last route first. Close the book takes 8 extra damage per hit: spend the two setup turns preparing a burst.

pattern.label: Record · repeating the last route costs 7 hull
Seal · sever 1 link for the round

enemies.name: The Witness Array
enemies.description: It remembers each route, then cuts the links that made it possible.

tactics.name: Cross-examination
tactics.counter: Witness has 4 armor; 5 disruption prevents the mark. Testimony takes 4 extra damage per hit. Interrupt Sever with 4 disruption. Rebuttal has 4 armor. Cross-examine sets up Final testimony: vent to avoid its +3 damage per saturated organ, then exploit its +7 damage taken per hit.

pattern.label: Witness · repeating the last route costs 8 hull
Sever · disable 1 link for the round
Cross-examine · add 2 strain before cooling to 5 organs

enemies.name: Pollen Drone
enemies.description: A small engine carrying too much spring.

tactics.name: Pollen shell
tactics.counter: Pollen lance has 2 armor; Seed dust takes 5 extra damage per hit. Secondary split hits gain 4 damage. Pick off its companions while it shelters, then finish it during dusting.

pattern.label: Seed dust · add 2 strain before cooling to 2 organs

enemies.name: Graft Stalker
enemies.description: Roots search for the seams in your hull.

tactics.name: Root and feed
tactics.counter: Take root cuts your last route first and can be stopped with 3 disruption. Graft drains actual hull damage; Tendril takes 5 extra damage per hit. Defend the middle turn, attack the last.

pattern.label: Take root · sever 1 link for the round

enemies.name: Sap Collector
enemies.description: It counts every drop that escapes.

tactics.name: Sap medic
tactics.counter: Tap drains actual hull damage. Sap wash repairs the group unless interrupted with 3 disruption. Press has 3 armor. Three-organ attacks gain 5 damage; focus it before its allies can be repaired.

pattern.label: Sap wash · heal every allied enemy by 6

enemies.name: Thorn Canticle
enemies.description: A flower that learned the shape of a weapon.

tactics.name: Thorn bloom
tactics.counter: Bloom has 4 armor while straining your busiest organs. Thornfall gains 2 damage per saturated organ but takes 6 extra damage per hit. Vent during Bloom and burst during Thornfall.

pattern.label: Bloom · add 2 strain before cooling to 3 organs

enemies.name: Orchard Titan
enemies.description: A wandering orchard of scarred metal.

tactics.name: Orchard seasons
tactics.counter: Regrow has 4 armor but 4 disruption cancels the repair. Bough takes 5 extra damage per hit. Root pressure can be interrupted with 4 disruption; Harvest drains actual hull damage.

pattern.label: Regrow · heal every allied enemy by 12
Root pressure · add 2 strain before cooling to 4 organs

enemies.name: The Root of All Suns
enemies.description: Its roots repair what its captive sun burns.

tactics.name: Solar growth cycle
tactics.counter: Entangle has 4 armor; Solar sap gains 3 damage per saturated organ. Germinate takes 4 extra damage per hit and 5 disruption stops the repair. Root flare drains actual hull damage. Alternate cooling, interruption and prevention.

pattern.label: Entangle · add 2 strain before cooling to 4 organs
Germinate · heal every allied enemy by 16

enemies.name: Index Ray
enemies.description: Its fins turn like unnumbered pages.

tactics.name: Fragile annotator
tactics.counter: Index takes 6 extra damage per hit and 2 disruption prevents its mark. Page edge has 3 armor. Burst or interrupt immediately; alternate routes if the mark lands.

pattern.label: Index · repeating the last route costs 3 hull

enemies.name: Undertow Scribe
enemies.description: It writes with the pull of a dark tide.

tactics.name: Gravity trap
tactics.counter: Drag has 3 armor. Gravity ink strains busy organs; Undertow gains 3 damage per saturated organ and takes 4 extra damage per hit. One-organ attacks gain 4 damage, leaving more room to vent.

pattern.label: Gravity ink · add 2 strain before cooling to 3 organs

enemies.name: Folio Leviathan
enemies.description: A library bound in one enormous spine.

tactics.name: Iron binding
tactics.counter: Binding has 6 armor per hit. Rebind takes 5 extra damage per hit and 3 disruption cancels its group repair. Save large hits for the binding; repeated small hits work when it opens.

pattern.label: Rebind · heal every allied enemy by 5

enemies.name: Gravity Moth
enemies.description: Its wings fold the shortest paths shut.

tactics.name: Double fold
tactics.counter: Fold cuts two links from your last route first; 3 disruption cancels both cuts. Weight takes 3 extra damage per hit. One-organ attacks gain 5 damage and require no conduits.

pattern.label: Fold · sever 2 links for the round

enemies.name: Keeper of the Depths
enemies.description: Every lost course returns to its shelves.

tactics.name: Depth lock
tactics.counter: Record can be stopped with 4 disruption. Pressure has 5 armor. Seal shelf takes 5 extra damage per hit and cuts the last route first. Deep water drains actual hull damage; keep defense for that turn.

pattern.label: Record · repeating the last route costs 5 hull
Seal shelf · sever 1 link for the round

enemies.name: The Drowned Catalogue
enemies.description: The archive repeats your routes in a voice deeper than sound.

tactics.name: Tidal ledger
tactics.counter: Remember has 4 armor but 4 disruption prevents its mark. Black tide drains actual hull damage. Restore record can be interrupted with 5 disruption. Closing volume takes 7 extra damage per hit: plan a finishing burst there.

pattern.label: Remember · repeating the last route costs 6 hull
Restore record · heal every allied enemy by 14

enemies.name: Spark Knight
enemies.description: A bright oath in a hollow suit of armor.

tactics.name: Dueling armor
tactics.counter: Challenge has 5 armor, then Riposte takes 5 extra damage per hit but gains 2 damage per saturated organ. Three-organ attacks gain 6 damage: exploit the long-route weakness without overheating before the counterstrike.

enemies.name: Corona Wisp
enemies.description: It dances wherever a current breaks.

tactics.name: Static discharge
tactics.counter: Static takes 4 extra damage per hit and 2 disruption cancels its strain. Arc gains 3 damage per saturated organ; Return stroke takes 3 extra damage per hit. Stop the setup or cool before Arc.

pattern.label: Static · add 2 strain before cooling to 2 organs

enemies.name: Storm Kite
enemies.description: Thin wings catch the lightning between ships.

tactics.name: Conduit hunter
tactics.counter: Snip has 3 armor and cuts the last route first. Thunderline gains 2 damage per saturated organ. Secondary split hits gain 7 damage; bait its cut away from your cooling route.

pattern.label: Snip · sever 1 link for the round

enemies.name: Arc Herald
enemies.description: Every announcement arrives as a strike.

tactics.name: Binding oath
tactics.counter: Proclamation has 3 armor. Oath takes 4 extra damage per hit and 3 disruption prevents its mark. Echoing oath drains actual hull damage. Exploit the announcement gap, then vary your defenses.

pattern.label: Oath · repeating the last route costs 3 hull

enemies.name: Thunder Regent
enemies.description: The crown’s last servant refuses to kneel.

tactics.name: Dividing scepter
tactics.counter: Scepter has 5 armor. Divide cuts two links from the last route first; 4 disruption cancels it. Judgment gains 3 damage per saturated organ but takes 6 extra damage per hit. Preserve a cool route for the finish.

pattern.label: Divide · sever 2 links for the round

enemies.name: The Crown Unbound
enemies.description: No circuit can hold its storm for long.

tactics.name: Storm coronation
tactics.counter: Shatter crown has 5 armor but 5 disruption cancels its two cuts. Royal thunder takes 6 extra damage per hit. Coronation can be interrupted with 4 disruption. Unbound arc gains 4 damage per saturated organ: keep cooling and alternate burst turns.

pattern.label: Shatter crown · sever 2 links for the round
Coronation · add 2 strain before cooling to 4 organs

events.name: A Warm Wreck
events.text: Something inside the wreck still beats. It has enough warmth for one more traveller.

events.name: The Thorn Orchard
events.text: A garden of antennae catches your wake. Bright salvage hangs between the thorns.

events.name: Drifting Chapel
events.text: The chapel’s little machines still answer visitors. Each blessing has a shape.

events.name: The Unwritten Chart
events.text: The chart has no stars, only the outline of your ship. A line is waiting for your hand.

events.name: The Bone Dock
events.text: A patient dock unfolds its tools. The price list is etched into a rib.

choices.label: Sell a piece of the hull
choices.detail: Reduce maximum hull by 8; receive 1 powerup.

events.name: The Small Beacon
events.text: A beacon broadcasts the sound of a safe harbour. Its supply compartment is still sealed.

events.name: The Shell Choir
events.text: Empty eggs sing when your engines pass. One note makes the old wounds close.

events.name: The Coal Midwife
events.text: A figure of soot offers a seed cupped in both hands. Her other hand points to your hull.

choices.label: Accept the seed
choices.detail: Reduce maximum hull by 8; receive 1 powerup.

events.name: The Minority Report
events.text: A dissenting machine slips a page beneath your airlock. Its argument is brief and useful.

events.name: The Orphan Foundry
events.text: The workers are gone. A single press still stamps tools for ships it will never see.

events.name: The Blind Observatory
events.text: Every telescope points inward. In the dark glass, a familiar command looks unnecessary.

events.name: The Last Address
events.text: A letter waits at the edge of the array. It is addressed to the ship you might become.

events.name: The Open Seed
events.text: A seed engine has rooted inside an empty repair cradle.

events.name: The Copper Orchard
events.text: Ripe conductors hang from a forest of silent coils.

events.name: The Unclaimed Volume
events.text: A dry book floats in the deepest current. Its pages remember a command you have not learned.

events.name: The Quiet Shelf
events.text: Between the moving shelves, the current leaves one little pocket of stillness.

events.name: The Fallen Diadem
events.text: A broken conductor-ring still holds a little charge.

events.name: The Storm Shelter
events.text: An old beacon grounds the storm long enough for a small repair.

regions.name: Cradle of Embers
regions.subtitle: Where the dead stars nest
regions.description: Warm ash gathers around a sun that has not decided to be born. Small scavengers drink the light leaking through its shell.

regions.name: The Choir of Wrecks
regions.subtitle: Every wreck has a vote
regions.description: Broken vessels drift into a slow river of metal. Their pieces convene beneath a parliament that refuses to adjourn.

regions.name: The Glass Beyond
regions.subtitle: Nothing passes unwitnessed
regions.description: Cold instruments measure the distance between a ship and its reflection. The final witness remembers every path you take.

regions.name: The Verdant Engine
regions.subtitle: Life grows around the machinery
regions.description: Copper roots and luminous pollen thread through abandoned engines. At their center, a living root grips a captive sun.

regions.name: The Tidal Archive
regions.subtitle: The deep remembers every voyage
regions.description: Gravity folds drowned shelves into an abyssal library. Its records drift on tides that pull every visitor toward a watching eye.

regions.name: The Crown of Storms
regions.subtitle: Every oath becomes lightning
regions.description: A broken ring of conductive spires draws lightning from the nebula. The storm chooses no ruler for long.

characters.name: The Cartographer
characters.description: A living circuit of six familiar organs. Order Lens, Fork and Echo to shape each command.

organs.name: The Lens
organs.description: Add 3 damage if this command already deals damage.

organs.name: The Fork
organs.description: The command also deals half its damage to every other enemy.

organs.name: The Echo
organs.description: Multiply damage and healing by 1.5, rounded down.

organs.name: The Suture
organs.description: Add 1 healing to the command.

organs.name: The Hush
organs.description: Add 2 disruption for this enemy phase. Combined disruption and redirection can prevent at most half of each attack.

organs.name: The Prism
organs.description: Redirect up to 3 damage from the chosen enemy’s next attack to another living enemy this phase. Does not stack or work against a lone enemy. Combined defense caps at half an attack.

characters.name: The Palimpsest
characters.description: Build up to 6 Trace with inscription, then spend it to recall damage, repair, redact or rewrite half a previous base command. Trace lasts through combat.

organs.name: Scribe
organs.description: Gain 2 Trace, up to 6.

organs.name: Splice
organs.description: At 2 or more Trace, split damage among other enemies at half strength. Otherwise add 2 damage to a damaging command.

organs.name: Recall
organs.description: For a damaging command, spend all Trace and add 2 damage per point spent.

organs.name: Palimend
organs.description: Spend 1 Trace to add 2 healing. No effect without Trace.

organs.name: Redact
organs.description: Spend 1 Trace to add 3 disruption this enemy phase; without Trace, add 1 disruption. Combined defense caps at half an attack.

organs.name: Rewrite
organs.description: Spend 2 Trace to add half the previous command’s base damage, healing and disruption, rounded down. No effect below 2 Trace.

characters.name: The Hollow Choir
characters.description: Alternate attack, repair and utility commands to gain Resonance, up to 3. Repeating a kind resets Resonance. Coordinate your organs, then spend Resonance on Crescendo, Cadence or Concert commands.

organs.name: Conductor
organs.description: Gain 1 Resonance, up to 3, on the first command or when its kind differs from the previous command.

organs.name: Chorus
organs.description: At 2 or more Resonance, split damage among other enemies at half strength. Otherwise add 1 damage to a damaging command.

organs.name: Crescendo
organs.description: Spend all Resonance. Add 2 damage per point to a damaging command, and 2 healing per point to a healing command.

organs.name: Rest
organs.description: Repair and utility commands gain 1 healing and 1 Resonance, up to 3. Attack commands gain neither.

organs.name: Dissonance
organs.description: Add 1 disruption plus your current Resonance this enemy phase. Combined defense caps at half an attack.

organs.name: Cadence
organs.description: Spend 2 Resonance to gain 3 ward. Cadence cannot raise ward above 3. No effect below 2 Resonance.
